name: Stolen Reality: The Thieve's Oasis
source:
New players! How wonderful!

Thank you for joining us, and welcome to Xisea.

The lives of a pair of high school dropouts take an interesting turn after a strange phantom leads them to a real-life multiplayer thief simulator. Even more so, they are granted a power unlike any other. Will they use their newfound abilities to beat out their competition? Or do they have another goal in mind? 

[from [url=https://cringebear.itch.io/stolen-reality-the-thieves-oasis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新玩家！多么美妙啊！

感谢你加入我们，欢迎来到西海。

一对高中辍学者的生活在一个奇怪的幽灵带领他们进入现实生活中的多人小偷模拟器后发生了有趣的转变。更重要的是，他们被赋予了不同于其他人的权力。他们会利用新发现的能力击败竞争对手吗？或者他们还有其他目标吗？

[来自[url=https://cringebear.itch.io/stolen-reality-the-thieves-oasis]Itch.io[/url]]
